GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 1-2l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 4 Lengths @ 1000m. fanned 3 Wide Straightening Up all Clear . Kept Finding line , bobbed right in three way go for 2nd # good trail/sound
Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, ran on well # hit line well
Jumped Ok sat box seat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on strong, no match winner who was $1.30 Fav # found 1 better
Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped. Near the 600m shifted in and made contact with the running rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat rail 4l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # held ground
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Lengths 1000m 4th 4 Lengths 600m 4th 4 Lengths Hard Ridden home turn 6th Under Pressure weakened badly final 200m # every chance/weak
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied when tightened rounding home turn. Directed inside heels near 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back near last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported after beginning awkwardly she obtained a trailing position behind a runner which she anticipated would take up a forward position, however when this runner failed to muster speed through the early stages, she became awkwardly placed on heels and was required to restrain her mnt, and as a result settled at the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to face breeze 1 length off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and gave ground # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start was contacted on the hindquarter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze half off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up half off, battled on well # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m, after commencing to race keenly, had to be eased when crowded for room to the inside of another runner which shifted in when not quite clear. The gelding then continued to race keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 1 length off 3 Wide No Cover , improved turn, joined in Straightening Up , headed 200m half off, battled on well, just no match once headed after Wide run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout the race.
